name: Have I Been Pwned
tagline: Check if your email or phone is in a data breach
mission: Have I Been Pwned is a free service that helps people find out if their personal data has been exposed in a data breach, and helps them understand what to do about it. It exists to give ordinary people the same visibility into data breaches that attackers already have, without charging them for the privilege.
values: Free and accessible to everyone, always
Transparent about data sources and methodology
Privacy-respecting in how data is collected, stored and shown
audience: Everyday internet users checking their own exposure
Organisations and developers integrating via the API
Government and enterprise subscribers to domain monitoring

colors.name: Black
colors.usage: Primary canvas colour for the website and product UI. Nearly all HIBP surfaces sit on true black, not dark grey.

colors.name: Grey 900
colors.usage: Elevated panels, cards, stat tiles and containers that sit above the black background.

colors.name: Grey 700
colors.usage: Dividers, input borders, card outlines and other low-emphasis structural lines.

colors.name: Grey 500
colors.usage: Secondary text, placeholder copy, captions, timestamps and disabled states.

colors.name: White
colors.usage: Primary text and iconography on dark backgrounds. Off-white, never pure #FFFFFF, to avoid glare on OLED screens.

colors.name: Pwned Blue
colors.usage: The single HIBP brand colour. Used once per view for the primary action: the Check button, links, the 'Pwned' half of the wordmark, and headline data points. Never used decoratively or repeated across multiple competing elements.

colors.name: Deep Navy
colors.usage: Paired with Pwned Blue in gradients and banner treatments (e.g. the footer call-to-action band). Not used standalone as an accent.

display.usage: Display headings 1-4 and the wordmark. Always italic when used as a logotype.

body.usage: Body copy, UI labels, buttons and form fields.

mono.usage: Not yet formalised in the existing design file. Recommended system monospace stack for API/code samples until a brand mono is chosen.

logo.primary: Two-line 'Have I Been / ‹;--Pwned' lockup, italic Switzer Bold, with the symbol inline before 'Pwned'. White on dark backgrounds, with 'Been' and 'Pwned' rendered in a white-to-blue (#F6F8FA → #1D72A7) gradient in the hero treatment.
logo.symbol: The stylised ';--' mark: five angled bars standing in for a password mask. Used alone as the favicon, social avatar and app icon.
logo.clearSpace: Keep clear space on all sides equal to the width of the tallest bar in the symbol. Never let text, imagery or UI chrome enter this zone.
logo.minSize: 24px for the symbol alone; 120px wide for the full wordmark lockup on screen; 15mm wide in print.
donts: Don't recolour the logo outside the defined brand palette
Don't stretch, skew or rotate the mark
Don't add drop shadows, outlines, bevels or other effects
Don't place the logo on busy imagery or low-contrast backgrounds
Don't recreate the wordmark in another typeface
Don't separate the symbol from its angled, italic construction

weAre: Transparent about what data is and isn't shown
User-first and free of sales pressure

registers.product: Concise and direct, written for a non-technical reader checking their own exposure.
registers.social: Slightly wry and dry, reflecting the tongue-in-cheek 'pwned' branding without undermining the seriousness of breaches.
registers.documentation: Precise, technical and example-driven for the API and developer audience.
registers.press: Measured, factual and credible, free of hype.
